CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS partners_bank_accounts (user_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,cipher TEXT NOT NULL,fingerprint VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,iban_last4 VARCHAR(4) NOT NULL,country VARCHAR(2) NOT NULL,changed_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,hold_until VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS partners_payouts (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,affiliate_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,period VARCHAR(7) NOT NULL,amount_minor INTEGER NOT NULL,recovery_minor INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,batch_id VARCHAR(64),account_cipher TEXT NOT NULL,account_fingerprint VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,request_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE,data MEDIUMTEXT NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,updated_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,INDEX partner_payout_owner (affiliate_id,created_at),INDEX partner_payout_batch (batch_id,status),INDEX partner_payout_period (affiliate_id,period))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS partners_payout_entries (payout_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,commission_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,amount_minor INTEGER NOT NULL,cash_minor INTEGER NOT NULL,recovery_minor INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,PRIMARY KEY(payout_id,commission_id),INDEX partner_payout_commission (commission_id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS partners_payout_batches (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,period VARCHAR(7) NOT NULL,status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,updated_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,INDEX partner_batch_period (period))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS partners_payout_evidence (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,payout_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE,cipher MEDIUMTEXT NOT NULL,sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,mime VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,bytes INTEGER NOT NULL,created_by VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS partners_campaigns (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,name VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,starts_at VARCHAR(40),ends_at VARCHAR(40),budget_minor INTEGER,spent_minor INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,data TEXT NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,updated_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,INDEX partner_campaign_active (status,starts_at,ends_at))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS partners_coupons (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,code VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL UNIQUE,affiliate_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,product_id VARCHAR(64),campaign_id VARCHAR(64),discount_bps INTEGER NOT NULL,starts_at VARCHAR(40),ends_at VARCHAR(40),budget_minor INTEGER,spent_minor INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,active TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,data TEXT NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,INDEX partner_coupon_owner (affiliate_id,active))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS partners_tiers (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,active TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,data TEXT NOT NULL)
